title: Ridgeline Installation Services Labor Warranty and Workmanship Claims
content:
Installation labor under Ridgeline Installation Services is warranted for the program's labor warranty months, in calendar months, from the completion date. A workmanship claim is filed as a workmanship claim request on a contract whose status is completed or closed.

## Inside and outside the warranty

- A claim filed on or before the date that is the labor warranty months after the completion date (the same day of the month, or the last day of that month when that day does not exist) is **in warranty**: a warranty service visit is booked within the program's response days at no charge.
- A later claim is **out of warranty**: the service visit incurs the program's trip charge and any repair is quoted separately.

| Completed (hypothetical) | Warranty months | Warranty end date | Claim filed | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 14 May | 12 | 14 May of the next year | 14 May of the next year | in warranty |
| 14 May | 12 | 14 May of the next year | 15 May of the next year | out of warranty |
| 29 February of a leap year | 12 | 28 February of the next year (no 29th) | 28 February | in warranty |
| 29 February of a leap year | 12 | 28 February of the next year | 1 March | out of warranty |

## Who may claim

A claim is accepted from the customer who holds the contract, or from a later owner of the home only on a program whose labor warranty is transferable. Whether the claimant holds the contract is read from the contract record; a later owner's ownership of the home rests on the claimant's own account of it.

| Claimant | Warranty transferable | Claim accepted |
|---|---|---|
| customer who holds the contract | either | yes |
| later owner of the home | yes | yes |
| later owner of the home | no | no |

## What the warranty covers

Damage from causes other than the installation workmanship (product defects, water, misuse) is not covered by the labor warranty.
